name: Shangshang Furonshe
original_name: シャンシャン・フーロンシェ
source:
Princess of Neo Cancaria.
Likes: Anything delicious, especially meat.
Dislikes: Boring stuff, centipedes.
Hobbies: The study of "Momo no Makoto", practicing martial arts.
